listings.title: 2016 Land Rover Range Rover Autobiography LWB
listings.description: Carpathian Gray over black leather, 101k miles. Supercharged 5.0 V8, LWB Autobiography. Panoramic roof, Meridian, rear-seat entertainment, cooler. Bumper scuffs, passenger-rear soft-close dead. Carfax accidents in 2020, open recall, lien on title.

listings.title: 1999 BMW 328i Convertible
listings.description: One-family-owned E36 in Avus Blue with a matching blue top, 64k miles. Soft top doesn’t power-retract and needs repair. Dings in the body, dent by the right headlight, loose door panels. Clean Carfax, clean Texas title.

listings.title: 1949 Plymouth Special Deluxe Club Coupe
listings.description: Black over striped cloth, 24k miles shown. 218ci L-head inline-six, 3-speed manual. Freshwater flood in a storage unit totaled by insurance; rebuilt salvage Texas title. Dry-rotting tires, paint imperfections, corroded rear bumper.

listings.title: 1969 Lincoln Continental Mark III
listings.description: 25-year owner. Dark Gray Metallic, black vinyl roof, dark red interior, 83k miles. 460 V8, C6 automatic, power seats, eight-track. Right-front power window is dead. Clean Texas title, Deluxe Marti Report included.

listings.title: Ferrari 360 Schedoni luggage set
listings.description: Three-piece Schedoni set for a 360: two hard cases plus a garment bag, prancing-horse logos.
